description: This file provides utility functions for command processing, including text normalization, substitution, and assertions, as well as a commented-out class for text proxy handling.

classes.name: TextProxy
classes.description: Commented-out class intended to simplify conversion between string and byte representations, providing a ValueObject for text data.

methods.name: template_substitute
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in text with provided keyword arguments.

methods.name: text_remove_empty_lines
methods.description: Removes empty lines and trailing whitespace from text.

methods.name: text_normalize
methods.description: Normalizes whitespace and line endings in text.

methods.name: text_normalize_line_endings
methods.description: Replaces Windows-style line endings with Unix-style.

methods.name: contains_substring_multiple_times
methods.description: Creates a matcher to check if a substring appears a specified number of times.

methods.name: assert_text_should_equal
methods.description: Asserts that two texts are equal.

methods.name: assert_text_should_not_equal
methods.description: Asserts that two texts are not equal.

methods.name: assert_text_should_contain_exactly
methods.description: Asserts that text contains a specific substring exactly.

methods.name: assert_text_should_not_contain_exactly
methods.description: Asserts that text does not contain a specific substring exactly.

methods.name: assert_text_should_contain
methods.description: Asserts that text contains a specific substring.

methods.name: assert_normtext_should_contain_multiple_times
methods.description: Asserts that normalized text contains a substring multiple times.

methods.name: assert_text_should_not_contain
methods.description: Asserts that text does not contain a specific substring.

methods.name: assert_normtext_should_equal
methods.description: Asserts that normalized texts are equal.

methods.name: assert_normtext_should_not_equal
methods.description: Asserts that normalized texts are not equal.

methods.name: assert_normtext_should_contain
methods.description: Asserts that normalized text contains a substring.

methods.name: assert_normtext_should_not_contain
methods.description: Asserts that normalized text does not contain a substring.

methods.name: assert_text_should_match_pattern
methods.description: Asserts that text matches a regex pattern.

methods.name: assert_text_should_not_match_pattern
methods.description: Asserts that text does not match a regex pattern.
